s1: Spreadsheets aren't the problem. Five of them are. Sales has one. The warehouse has another. Accounts has a third. So which number is right? In one system, everyone works from the same numbers. SynQuanta builds it around how you work.
s2: The system says forty. The shelf says twelve. When sales and stock live in different places, the numbers drift apart. In one system, every sale updates your stock, so the count you see is the count you have.
s3: A distributor's day, in one system. An order comes in. Stock is set aside for it. The delivery goes out. The invoice is sent, and the payment comes in. Everyone sees the same order, from start to finish.
s4: You told us about your business. So, what happens next? First, a real person on our team reads every answer. Then we reply by email within one working day, with first thoughts. And then we meet, map how you work, and plan the first step together.
s5: Five signs you've outgrown spreadsheets. One: two people, two different numbers. Two: reports take hours. Three: only one person knows how it all works. Four: the same order gets typed twice. Five: you can't easily see who still owes you. Sound familiar? It might be time for one system, built around how you work.
s6: What happens when the one person who knows everything is away? Orders wait. Questions pile up. Nobody can find the right file. When your business knowledge lives in one system, not one person, work keeps moving. SynQuanta builds that system around how you work.
